latestVersion.changelog:
Version 0.1.1 of ai-search-rank-tracker introduces a built-in prompt database for larger and more granular AI search visibility scans.

- Added prompt database under prompt-db/ with categories: SaaS, AI tools, Developer tools, OpenClaw ecosystem, and Local AI tools.
- Each prompt includes category and commercial metadata for grouping and analysis by intent, journey stage, and buyer value.
- Updated documentation to reflect the new prompt database and its usage.
- No changes to core tracking or reporting logic; main enhancement is prompt management and metadata.
- Improved organization for running larger GEO / AI SEO scans.
